description: This source file contains unit tests for the WindowPlacement utility, validating window positioning functions such as centered frame, top-right frame, and ensuring on-screen placement within a macOS application.

classes.name: WindowPlacementTests
classes.description: A suite of Swift unit tests for validating the behavior of window placement functions in a macOS application.

methods.name: centered frame zero bounds falls back to origin
methods.description: Tests that the centeredFrame function returns a frame at origin when given zero bounds.

methods.name: centered frame clamps to bounds and centers
methods.description: Validates that centeredFrame correctly centers within bounds and clamps sizes accordingly.

methods.name: top right frame zero bounds falls back to origin
methods.description: Checks that topRightFrame defaults to origin when given zero bounds.

methods.name: top right frame clamps to bounds and applies padding
methods.description: Ensures topRightFrame applies padding and clamps within bounds properly.

methods.name: ensure on screen uses fallback when window offscreen
methods.description: Verifies that ensureOnScreen moves an offscreen window to a fallback position.

methods.name: ensure on screen does not move visible window
methods.description: Checks that ensureOnScreen does not move a window that is already visible within the screen's visible frame.
